prompt:
Pixel art mascot sprite for the zodiac sign ARIES: a round little ram, front view, with big curly horns like cinnamon rolls and a small tuft of wool on top, bouncing forward, centred inside a thin-lined hexagon frame with a ring of small jolly flames behind it. Personality: eager, brave, a bit of a show-off.

Mood: friendly, quirky and charming, like a cheerful mascot from an early-1990s Japanese console game. Chunky rounded shapes, a big head, large simple oval eyes with one white glint each, a tiny mouth, stubby proportions, a slightly cheeky expression. Cute and funny, never fierce: no fangs, no snarl, no angry brow, no realistic fur or muscle detail. An original character, not any existing game character.

Style: 16-bit console pixel art, hard square pixels, no anti-aliasing, no blur, no gradients, no dithering. Drawn on a 96 x 96 pixel grid, shown enlarged so each pixel is a clear square. Thick dark outline around every shape. Flat solid black background filling the whole image, never white.

Palette: exactly four bright flat colours plus black: cream, tomato red, orange, navy blue. At most two flat shades of each, nothing else.

Composition: symmetrical, the character fills about 60% of the frame, eyes and mouth drawn as clearly separate shapes. Square image, no text, no letters, no watermark, no signature.
